598:t_7:13.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Surely you and that boy... and those guided by the $$ガンダム$$, along with their companions...」

598:t_7:14.en:
$$サイアム$$
「will overcome even the despair that defeated me and $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

598:t_7:15.en:
$$サイアム$$
(Isn't that right, my trusted friends...?)

598:t_7:17.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Princess $$ミネバ$$... I would like you to tell the truth yourself... Our only wish... to the people living in this ugly yet beloved world...」

598:t_7:20.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I was not the only one who dreamed this day would come, living in the $$宇宙世紀$$...」

598:t_7:21.en:
$$サイアム$$
「My trusted friends were also making preparations for this day.」

598:t_7:23.en:
$$ガエル$$
「$$サイアム$$... We have a transmission from $$ナナイ・ミゲル$$ aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

598:t_7:24.en:
$$サイアム$$
「So its system has activated as well.」

598:t_7:25.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Why is the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$...?」

598:t_7:26.en:
$$サイアム$$
「It was decided. If the day came when someone opened $$ラプラスの箱$$, the truth at its very depths would also be told.」

598:t_7:28.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Originally, $$リカルド・マーセナス$$ was to reveal it to the people at the dawn of the $$宇宙世紀$$...」

598:t_7:29.en:
$$サイアム$$
「But he died before fulfilling his ambition, and that secret was buried in darkness along with the true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter.」

598:t_7:30.en:
$$サイアム$$
「That is the truth that will shake this multiverse... every parallel world...」

598:t_7:31.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「It will be revealed along with $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

598:t_7:32.en:
$$サイアム$$
「Now, let us begin. $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$... and $$エルガン・ローディック$$...」

598:t_7:33.en:
$$サイアム$$
(Perhaps we will bring despair to this world.)

598:t_7:34.en:
$$サイアム$$
(But let us believe that the young people who carry the future will overcome it.)

598:t_7:39.en:
$$トライア$$
「What thoughts are you sending beyond the night sky?」

598:t_7:41.en:
$$トライア$$
「It has been a long time.」

598:t_7:42.en:
$$トライア$$
「Was the last time we met at my college graduation...?」

598:t_7:44.en:
$$トライア$$
「It took me quite a while to find you after you retired.」

598:t_7:45.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$カルロス・アクシオン$$.」

598:t_7:47.en:
$$トライア$$
「No... Allow me to call you $$クロノ$$'s $$キング$$.」

598:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As our proprietor $$ＡＧ$$ is absent today, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will be operated by our unattended service.」

598:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please understand that celebrations for ace pilots must wait until another occasion.」

598:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

599:t_000:0.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「It seems we arrived ahead of $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

599:t_000:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's thanks to the two-stage diversion by $c and the $$プトレマイオス２$$.」

599:t_000:2.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$メガラニカ$$... $$ラプラスの箱$$ is there.」

599:t_001:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You didn't have to come with me, too.」

599:t_001:1.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have a right... no, a duty to see this through, too.」

599:t_001:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...All right, $$オードリー$$. I won't say it again.」

599:t_001:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go, for the future so many people entrusted to us, too.」

599:t_002:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You didn't have to come with me, too.」

599:t_002:1.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have a right... no, a duty to see this through, too.」

599:t_002:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...All right, $$オードリー$$. I won't say it again.」

599:t_002:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go, for the future $$マリーダ$$ entrusted to us, too.」

599:t_003:0.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「The Leader and the Royal Guard have reached $$インダストリアル７$$.」

599:t_003:1.en:
$$ヒル$$
「We'll intercept $c here. Do not let them through.」

599:t_004:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$バナージ$$ and Princess $$ミネバ$$ appear to be inside $$メガラニカ$$ already!」

599:t_004:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So we've succeeded so far.」

599:t_004:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I don't see $$フル・フロンタル$$ among the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces.」

599:t_004:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The Royal Guard isn't here either. That means he's holding back in the rear...」

599:t_004:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Then we'll smash the front line and drag them out!」

599:t_004:6.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The world $$フル・フロンタル$$ creates... Those who believe in a future where time has all but stopped...」

599:t_004:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「This battle... Is it a second battle over the $$時の牢獄$$?」

599:t_004:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah! The real future lies beyond it!」

599:t_004:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
($$バナージ$$... Leave this to us.)

599:t_004:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
(We're waiting for you and $$ミネバ$$ to grasp the truth.)

599:t_004:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「Keep calling him, Ensign $$ミヒロ$$. I'm sure he's here, too.」

599:t_004:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Hold the line and wait for $$バナージ$$ here! Watch out for reinforcements, too!」

599:t_004:17.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$... is nearby.」

599:t_004:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Does that man intend to interfere with humanity's final battle against itself and throw everything into chaos?」

599:t_004:19.en:
$$甲児$$
「That bastard is rotten to the core.」

599:t_004:20.en:
$$シモン$$
「This is a good chance. Let's take on $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and him together.」

599:t_004:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin the attack! We'll end the battle with $$ネオ・ジオン$$... the fighting among Earth's humanity... right here!」

599:t_006:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What's this...? Things aren't very exciting.」

599:t_006:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shut up. We're not risking our lives to amuse you.」
